description: This Python source file defines a FastAPI router handling report-related endpoints for a backend API. It includes routes for retrieving overview metrics and exporting datasets such as users, classes, bookings, workouts, and payments as CSV files. Access is restricted to admin users, and the code interacts with a database via SQLAlchemy ORM models and session dependencies.

classes.name: OverviewMetrics
classes.description: Pydantic model representing various summary metrics for reports.

methods.description: Calculates and returns the sum from a SQLAlchemy statement.

methods.name: OverviewMetrics _overview(db: Session)
methods.description: Generates an OverviewMetrics object with summarized data from the database.

methods.name: str _csv_from_rows(headers: List[str], rows: List[Tuple])
methods.description: Creates a CSV string from headers and rows.

methods.description: API endpoint that returns the overall report metrics; restricted to admin users.
